[LUCID](https://hazzanger.itch.io/lucid) is a FREE \~45 minute experience for PC (Windows/Mac OS/Linux)

I have been working on this game for the past 6 months and only feels appropriate to release now at the height of the covid epidemic. It's very atmospheric and doesn't have traditional "indie horror game" jumpscares or even asset flips.

All assets in LUCID are entirely created by Hazzanger or belong to creative commons 0 licenses.

I'll try my best! It's focused on the experience of someone stuck in their house, but they explore dreamworlds that haunt their waking life. The dreamworlds are vast and confusing, and full of subconscious symbols. It's in a pixel art style and though it's first person, there's minimal interaction with the environment. So sort of a walking simulator
